description: A short plain-language note from the birth chart on one area of life: the area's main house, its sign and how strong it is. The planet that guides the area, its other houses, support from planets and timing are not included. Areas: career, relationships, wealth, home_property, children, education, foreign_settlement, spiritual_growth. Health is not covered. Up to 3 answers per birth date and town every 7 days, shared with chart_overview and current_chapter. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer; a one-way code of the birth date and town is kept for 7 days to apply fair-use limits.

area.description: One of: career, relationships, wealth, home_property, children, education, foreign_settlement, spiritual_growth.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as recorded, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
